prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: Black Scarab career guide editorial hero, cinematic wide 16:9 landscape. Visual thesis: one engineer makes a vast computational effort serve intelligent robots. Create a striking, sophisticated near-future cinematic editorial scene with dramatic architectural scale and emotional curiosity. Camera very low and wide behind a small anonymous engineer seen from the back, standing on an elevated narrow bridge in the lower-left foreground. The person wears understated dark technical clothing, face and gender not identifiable, no screen in front of them. Ahead and below, immense graphite compute columns rise through a deep cathedral-like atrium in layered perspective, with convincing hardware detail mostly lost in elegant shadow, a monumental sense of depth and height. A single disciplined amber-lit service and data spine leads the eye through the space toward a distant glass robotics test bay, where a few pale articulated robots are just visible working with objects. The human is small relative to the architecture; the primary subject is the scale of the training systems and the connection to physical machines. Off-center composition, strong diagonal leading lines, atmospheric silver backlight, subtle reflections and a little haze, rich chiaroscuro with readable detail. Professional engineering publication quality, cinematic realism and imaginative editorial interpretation, not a stock server-room photograph. Palette about 80–90 percent true charcoal, black, silver, white and gray; 10–20 percent deliberate vivid amber light and small amber hardware accents, no overall orange wash. Clear at thumbnail size, one dominant visual idea. No text, numbers, labels, logos, screens with dashboards, diagrams, floating UI panels, holographic network graphs or watermark. Do not create an isolated product, tabletop miniature, isometric cutaway, ecommerce packshot, white seamless backdrop or centered rack inventory. Entirely original conceptual editorial illustration, not an official facility or product photograph.
